description: The loop-closing onboarding check: call after seeding (or any time you're asked 'are we done? what's next?'). Two-gate model: Gate 1 (forecast foundation — sales history + demand signal + current inventory) must clear before Gate 2 (purchasing foundation — default suppliers + item costs + lead times) becomes actionable. A gate clears at a minimum (some products covered), not at a share of the catalog. Returns an overall verdict (ready | almost_ready | not_ready), per-gate verdicts, and an ORDERED next-step list naming the exact tool for each remaining gap — including, as soon as Gate 1 clears, running the seeded Daily reorder sweep now (run_rule_now, with the ruleId in arguments) so the first low-stock signal lands today, and, when both gates clear, kicking off the first replenishment mission, followed by optional improvements (covering the rest of the catalog). Pure read; a client-pinned credential is verified against its own client's data, while an unpinned 3PL operator can pass clientId to verify one client.

clientId.description: Optional client id for a 3PL operator view. Client-pinned credentials omit it.
